summary: Entry-level AWS and DevOps Engineer with 1 year of hands-on experience in AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, Docker and monitoring as an AWS Administrator Intern and DevOps Trainer. Built serverless, chatbot and automation projects using Lambda, API Gateway and Amazon Lex. Skilled in IAM least-privilege security, containerization, and automation.

highlights: Delivered hands-on training on AWS core services, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices.
Designed practical lab exercises on Docker, Jenkins, and Linux automation to reinforce real-world DevOps workflows.
Mentored learners in interview preparation, troubleshooting, and capstone project reviews.
Provisioned and configured EC2 instances, including VPC setup, security groups, and key pair management.
Assisted in building CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild using buildspec.yml and appspec.yml.
Containerized applications with Docker, managing image versioning and lifecycle across dev and staging.
Supported automated deployments via AWS CodeDeploy and built Amazon CloudWatch dashboards and alarms.

projects.title: AI-Powered Dockerfile Generator using Local LLMs (2026)
projects.description: Built a Python automation tool using a local LLM via Ollama to generate production-ready Dockerfiles. Parsed dependency files (package.json, requirements.txt) contextually and validated Dockerfiles across multiple runtimes.

projects.title: Serverless Contact Form with Email Notifications (2026)
projects.description: Built a serverless contact form using S3 static hosting, API Gateway, Python Lambda, and SES to dispatch automated emails upon form submission with IAM bucket policies.

projects.title: PizzaBot – Conversational Chatbot (2026)
projects.description: Engineered a conversational pizza-ordering bot using Amazon Lex V2 with custom intents (OrderPizza, Greeting, Help) and slots (PizzaSize, PizzaType), deploying aliases for full order lifecycle confirmation.

projects.title: CI/CD Pipeline Automation (2025)
projects.description: Containerized applications with Docker and established automated Jenkins CI/CD builds with CloudWatch alerting and IAM least-privilege role policies.

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
